requests.zh: 整张室内合照明显压暗，保留两人的五官和肤色。
requests.en: Noticeably darken the whole indoor group portrait while keeping both faces recognizable and their skin tones natural.

requests.zh: 整张人像明显压暗，脸的轮廓与五官仍可辨。
requests.en: Noticeably darken the whole portrait while retaining a recognizable profile and facial features.

requests.zh: 明显压暗整张霓虹灯人像，保留脸部五官和霓虹灯颜色。
requests.en: Noticeably darken the whole neon portrait while retaining recognizable facial features and the neon colours.

requests.zh: 整张室内合照稍微压暗，保留每个人脸上的表情和皮肤细节。
requests.en: Slightly darken the whole indoor group photo, keeping each face and expression legible.

requests.zh: 把整张人像明显压暗，保留眼睛、五官和肤色。
requests.en: Noticeably darken the whole portrait, keeping the eyes, facial features and skin tone clear.

requests.zh: 整张傍晚人像明显压暗，车灯和背景一起变暗，人物五官仍可辨认。
requests.en: Noticeably darken the whole dusk portrait, including the car lights and background, while keeping the face recognizable.

requests.zh: 把整张照片稍微压暗，保留脸、帽檐和明亮云层的细节。
requests.en: Slightly darken the whole photograph, preserving the face, hat brim and bright cloud detail.

requests.zh: 整张野花风景稍微压暗，保留草地和天空层次。
requests.en: Slightly darken the whole wildflower landscape, preserving the grass and sky detail.

requests.zh: 明显压暗整张城市景色，保留天空和建筑的明暗层次。
requests.en: Noticeably darken the whole city scene, retaining the tonal detail of the sky and buildings.

requests.zh: 明显压暗整张林边夜景，仍保留汽车和树的轮廓。
requests.en: Noticeably darken the whole woodland night scene while keeping the car and tree outlines legible.

requests.zh: 整张城市远景稍微压暗，保留楼群轮廓和天空颜色过渡。
requests.en: Slightly darken the whole city skyline, keeping building silhouettes and the colour gradient in the sky.

r30_reuse_fit: All ten R30 fit photos and previously held p479 (no usable candidate). p162 retained only for regression. Never count either as fresh.
face_method: Use only existing OpenCV frontalface_default and profileface cascades on scaled source. Detect under equalized and CLAHE gray, frontal and mirrored profiles. Boxes are frozen on input and mapped to candidate crops. No held annotation or crop used as detector input. In face-preservation requests use presence, darkest interior luminance quantiles and change. Missing detection is unresolved, not proof of a bad edit.
fit: Compare serialized R30 baseline with two logistic selectors fitted on exactly the same R31 data: global-only vs global plus face features. Balanced C=.3 fixed. Threshold from leave-one-original-out top choices, maximizing completed choices without admitting a partial or failure on calibration. Inspect both delivery and correct abstention, no threshold tuning on held or p162.
safety: For separate conservative variant, absent detected face on an explicit face-preservation instruction yields no result. Do not claim no face exists. New source holdout has four portraits and four landscapes. AI full and native review before scoring, original group count not translated versions. No promotion from this small test.
